claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics.usageLimit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Action Surge at L17 permits 2 uses per Short/Long Rest but restricts spending to once per turn. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no per-turn usage limit field. MasteryMechanics has MasteryUsageLimit { kind: 'once_per_turn' } but that concept is not available on class feature mechanics. A new optional field (e.g. usageLimit?: { kind: 'once_per_turn' }) on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics would capture this constraint.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.
